blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateClaimStoreCreditAccountInputStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates the input for claiming a store credit account. It throws an
error if the code or customer ID is missing, or if the customer does not have a
registered account.

children.name: ValidateClaimStoreCreditAccountInputStepInput
children.description: Input to validate that a store credit account claim request is valid.
